content: Caregiver sync is universal table stakes: Huckleberry (free multi-caregiver sync), Nighp (multi-device), Baby Connect (daycare/nanny real-time), Cubtale (real-time family), Nara (invite partners/grandparents), Feed Baby (device sync), JP PiyoLog (couple real-time sharing marketed), FR Le Baby (iCloud), Ninou (per-person roles). Every verified competitor has it free. BabyLog defers to manual local transfer R2 - biggest table-stakes gap.
